story.title: Trained on the quay, not behind a desk
paragraphs: {siteName} was founded to provide truly independent surveyors at Venezuela's ports: professionals who answer only to the technical evidence, with no conflict of interest with carriers, terminals or shippers.
Over time, we expanded our coverage to the main ports of the Caribbean and built a team capable of handling everything from a routine draft survey to a complex, time-pressured cargo damage claim.

missionVision.mission: To deliver accurate, timely and impartial marine surveys that reduce the risk and uncertainty of every cargo operation.
missionVision.vision: To be the regional reference in cargo and marine surveying, recognised for our technical rigor and our availability.
